description: This file re-exports functions and types from various modules related to QMD/session/query helpers used by the memory engine.

classes.name: SessionFileEntry
classes.description: Type representing an entry for session files, imported from session-files module

methods.name: extractKeywords
methods.description: Function for extracting keywords used in query expansion

methods.name: isQueryStopWordToken
methods.description: Function to identify if a token is a query stop word

methods.name: buildSessionEntry
methods.description: Function to build a session file entry

methods.name: listSessionFilesForAgent
methods.description: Lists session files for a specific agent

methods.name: sessionPathForFile
methods.description: Generates the file path for a session

methods.name: parseQmdQueryJson
methods.description: Parses QMD query JSON into result objects

methods.name: QmdQueryResult
methods.description: Type representing the result of a QMD query parse

methods.name: deriveQmdScopeChannel
methods.description: Derives the QMD scope channel from context

methods.name: deriveQmdScopeChatType
methods.description: Derives the QMD scope chat type

methods.name: isQmdScopeAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a particular QMD scope is allowed

methods.name: checkQmdBinaryAvailability
methods.description: Verifies if the required QMD binary is available

methods.name: resolveCliSpawnInvocation
methods.description: Resolves the CLI invocation command for QMD

methods.name: runCliCommand
methods.description: Runs a CLI command related to QMD

calls: export { buildSessionEntry, listSessionFilesForAgent, sessionPathForFile, type SessionFileEntry } from "./host/session-files.js"
